ItemID: unavailable; Title: The End of Heartache; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The mix of heavy riffs and melodic vocals fits what I enjoy in In Flames and Soilwork; I would choose this now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its aggressive sound and melodic passages appeal to me after Ten Thousand Fists; I would try it today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The intricate guitar work sounds appealing, but I would prioritize the heavier selections this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Sickness; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Having recently listened to Ten Thousand Fists, I would like to explore more of Disturbed's earlier sound.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Meteora; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic hooks and heavy passages fit my taste, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The War Within; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The sharp riffs and aggressive delivery fit my interest in Advance And Vanquish; I would choose this.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Ascendancy       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic metal sound interests me, but I already have enough albums picked for this visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Through the Eyes       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy grooves fit my listening, though I am more interested in the other selections right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I enjoy some melodic rock, but its gothic atmosphere is not what I am looking for today.
